source: Quran.com (text_uthmani), read via the quran.com verse pages/API. 3:42 and 19:26 are excerpts (the clauses shown). Re-run a verse check against quran.com before publishing (H81).

3:42.excerpt: ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
3:42.translation: Allah has chosen you, and purified you, and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

19:16.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
19:16.translation: She withdrew from her family to an eastern place.

19:17.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
19:17.translation: She put up a screen between them and herself.

19:23.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
19:23.translation: I wish I had died before this, and been something forgotten, completely forgotten.

19:26.translation: So eat, and drink, and be comforted.
